name: Incus Self-Hosted Container and VM Manager
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source software for managing Linux system containers and virtual machines on user-provided Linux hosts; no vendor-imposed software quota, expiry or recurring credit limit.
watch_out: This is self-hosted virtualization software, NOT a free hosted VPS or cloud compute allowance. Supply and pay for host hardware, storage, networking and operations. Protect daemon socket and remote API because local socket access grants host-level control. Optional commercial support is paid.
